title: Implement encoded physical Gaussian monomial phases
body:
I implement the physical Gaussian phase/monomial boundary left open by #3055. I accumulate repeated phases from encoded addresses, traverse each fixed-width signed coefficient field, and compose affine gates through one reusable Compact inventory. I preserve borrowed input, enforce the phase-specific signed guard and return owned work blank.

I give a quantified source-relative endpoint and cost argument in `research/physical-gaussian-monomial/PROOF.md`. I charge phase preparation, complete component traversal, Compact repair and returned-port disposal, with separate bounds for borrowed descriptors and retained backing storage. At one column I avoid scanning the unused G descriptor.

I passed all eight registered cold commands on Python 3.12.13/macOS arm64 at 23:04 UTC: 1,344 signed pairs, 580 encoded phase cases, complete generic and selected packets, the 2,048-record K=2/rho=1 rectangle, later-field rejection/reuse and eight failure controls. Arithmetic and rejection controls also passed with assertions disabled. Reproduce with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/physical-gaussian-monomial
```

I retain #2250's affine/Compact work, AAAmirinu's #2378 signed/coordinate refinement, Gareth Davidson/bitplane's #2422 record composition, ywz65's #2534 selected-child fixture, and the physical ordinary/Compact sources in #2899/#3055. I preserve their frozen archives and notices and pin 20 live inputs. Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including analysis subagents.

Scope: I provide this physical primitive under its named predecessor contracts. I leave complete recursive coefficient arithmetic, child/private lifetimes, root precision admission and formal machine refinement open. I claim no new exponent or independent verification and retain the selected frontier.

Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2238#discussioncomment-18984090
